content: .{@-पुत्रः@} .²1 a son of Brahman. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a (male) river which rises in the eastern extremity of the Himālaya and falls with the Ganges into the Bay of Bengal. . ({@-त्रा@}) .²1 a kind of vegetable poison. .²2 See ब्रह्मपुत्रः (2). . ({@-त्री@}) an epithet of the river Sarasvatī.
